records.summary: 高质量真实室内重建作为仿真资产；常见 RGB-D SLAM 轨迹是另外渲染的派生产品。

en.Projection and inputs: Official release centers on textured meshes and a renderer, not one fixed RGB-D sequence. Perspective frame resolution/intrinsics depend on the chosen renderer.
en.Depth and validity: Depth is rendered from reconstructed geometry. Serialization scale, range/Z and invalid pixels must be checked for the specific trajectory export.
en.Ground truth: Dense meshes, semantic/instance and plane annotations; glass/mirror metadata. Rendered poses are simulator references, not physical tracking measurements.
en.Calibration and timing: Trajectory and camera calibration are renderer inputs. No physical IMU synchronization guarantee follows from the asset release.
en.Evaluation: Name the exact sequence producer, scene list, coordinate convention and depth scale. Avoid training on the same underlying room through another derivative.

zh.投影与输入: 官方以纹理网格和渲染器为主，不是固定的一套 RGB-D 序列；透视帧分辨率、内参由渲染配置决定。
zh.深度与有效性: 深度来自重建几何渲染。序列导出的数值缩放、径向距离或 Z、无效像素规则必须逐版本核对。
zh.真值来源: 提供稠密网格、语义实例、平面及玻璃镜面信息；渲染位姿是仿真参考，不是物理跟踪测量。
zh.标定与时间: 轨迹和相机标定由渲染者设置；资产发布本身不包含物理 IMU 同步保证。

records.summary: 真实建筑扫描是许多全景深度基准的基础；原始 RGB-D 采集与渲染 ERP 派生集需要分别处理。

en.Projection and inputs: Three RGB-D sensors capture 18 views per tripod station; skyboxes and calibrated perspective images are provided. Published ERP depth protocols are derived products.
en.Depth and validity: Original 16-bit depth is camera Z: meters = value / 4000; zero is invalid. Do not copy this scale or Z convention to rendered ERP range.
en.Geometry and annotations: Sensor depth, reconstructed meshes, region/object semantics, intrinsics and camera-to-world poses; pose translations are meters.
en.Timing and calibration: Per-view intrinsics/extrinsics are supplied. Rotating static scan stations are not continuous synchronized VIO sequences.
en.Evaluation: Keep building identities separated. State whether using native depth, 3D60, Pano3D, or another ERP renderer and its mask/crop.

zh.几何与标注: 包含传感器深度、重建网格、区域和物体语义、内参与相机到世界位姿；位姿平移使用米。
zh.时间与标定: 提供逐视图内外参；旋转式静态扫描站不是连续同步的 VIO 序列。
zh.评测协议: 按建筑隔离训练和测试；注明使用原始深度、3D60、Pano3D 或其他 ERP 渲染版本及掩码、裁剪。

en: Many datasets reuse these buildings; combining derivatives does not create an independent test set.
zh: 多个派生集复用这些建筑，合并后不能视为独立测试集。

records.summary: 标准室内透视 RGB-D 基线；需严格区分实测 rawDepths 与补全后的 depths。

en.Projection and inputs: Kinect RGB/depth videos plus synchronized labeled RGB-D pairs in a MATLAB file; not fisheye or ERP.
en.Depth and validity: Both depths and aligned rawDepths are expressed in meters. depths fills missing values; rawDepths preserves holes before filling.
en.Ground truth: Structured-light sensor depth and semantic/instance labels. Inpainted pixels are processed supervision, not additional physical measurements.
en.Timing and calibration: Raw RGB and depth streams are unsynchronized with varying 20–30 FPS; timestamps and toolbox synchronization/calibration functions are supplied.
en.Evaluation: Disclose labeled/raw training subset, official split file, crop, depth cap and mask. Avoid using held-out scene raw frames for training.

zh.投影与输入: Kinect RGB、深度视频及 MATLAB 文件中的同步标注 RGB-D 图像对，不是鱼眼或 ERP。
zh.深度与有效性: depths 与对齐后的 rawDepths 均以米表示；depths 填补缺失值，rawDepths 保留补全前空洞。
zh.真值来源: 结构光传感器深度与语义实例标注；补全像素属于处理后监督，不是新增物理测量。
zh.时间与标定: 原始 RGB、深度不同步，帧率在 20–30 FPS 间变化；提供时间戳、同步及标定工具。
zh.评测协议: 说明标注、原始训练子集、划分文件、裁剪、深度上限和掩码；不能用留出场景的原始帧训练。

records.summary: 真实 Kinect RGB-D 序列与独立动作捕捉位姿，适合米制 RGB-D SLAM 和重建对照。

en.Inputs: 640×480 RGB and measured depth, nominally 30 Hz; timestamps are provided separately.
en.Depth convention: 16-bit PNG values divided by 5000 give metres; zero indicates missing depth. Released RGB/depth are registered.
en.Pose reference: Motion-capture trajectories at 100 Hz; pose format is timestamp tx ty tz qx qy qz qw in the reference world.
en.Calibration: Use the per-camera parameters and dataset notes; do not apply a second distortion correction to already registered depth.
en.Evaluation: Associate timestamps and apply the published ATE/RPE tools; retain depth holes and masks.

zh.输入: 640×480 RGB 与实测深度，标称 30 Hz；各自提供时间戳。
zh.深度约定: 16 位 PNG 除以 5000 得到米，零值表示缺测；发布的 RGB/深度已经配准。
zh.位姿参考: 100 Hz 动作捕捉轨迹；格式为时间戳、平移 tx ty tz 和四元数 qx qy qz qw。
zh.标定: 使用各相机参数及数据说明；不要对已经配准的深度再次做畸变校正。
zh.评测: 先关联时间戳，再用官方 ATE/RPE 工具；保留深度空洞及有效掩码。

en: Measured Kinect depth is noisy and incomplete, not perfect dense geometry.
Kinect accelerometer data is not a full gyro–accelerometer IMU.
zh: Kinect 实测深度有噪声和缺测，并非完美稠密几何。
Kinect 加速度数据不是完整的陀螺仪–加速度计 IMU。
